summary: EHang Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of its second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The report details revenue of RMB77.9 million, a 203.5% quarter-over-quarter increase, gross margin of 61.2%, and net loss of RMB128.3 million. It also highlights operational progress, including eVTOL sales, regulatory sandbox programs, and a global fast-track initiative. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring is mentioned. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure under SEC Rule 13a-16 for foreign private issuers, with no transaction terms or strategic action to analyze.
